name: nano-beauty
description: Nano Beauty customer + role-gated staff app (Expo) and clinic API (Fastify).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run config:check -w @nano/mobile && npm run release:audit
scripts.release:android:qa: node scripts/release-gate.mjs qa && cd apps/mobile && eas build --platform android --profile qa --non-interactive
scripts.release:android:store: node scripts/release-gate.mjs production && cd apps/mobile && eas build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.release:ios:testflight: node scripts/release-gate.mjs testflight && cd apps/mobile && eas build --platform ios --profile testflight --non-interactive
scripts.release:ios:store: node scripts/release-gate.mjs production && cd apps/mobile && eas build --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive
